project-schedule-overlap.title: Cross-project schedule overlaps
project-schedule-overlap.description: See when a member has scheduled work in multiple accessible projects on the same date.
project-schedule-overlap.invalid_week: Choose a Monday. Use This week to reset the view.
project-schedule-overlap.invalid_snapsho: The response does not match the selected week.
project-schedule-overlap.scope_limit: This week has too many scheduled tasks to check at once. Select another week.
project-schedule-overlap.empty_hint: No member has scheduled work in multiple accessible projects on the same date this week.
project-schedule-overlap.scope_note: This view uses planned task dates from projects you can access. Availability and workload are tracked separately in project capacity.
